title: Aliform
summary: ALI'FORM, adjective [Latin ala, wing, and forma, shape.] Having the shape of a wing; a term applied to a certain process and muscles of the body, as the pterygoid process, and the muscles arising from

inlines.v: ALI'FORM, adjective [Latin ala, wing, and forma, shape.] Having the shape of a wing; a term applied to a certain process and muscles of the body, as the pterygoid process, and the muscles arising from that process.
